legal_units.title: Service of notice in case of discontinued business.
legal_units.text: Where an assessment is to be made under section 320, the Assessing Officer may serve on the— a notice containing all or any of the requirements which may be included in a notice under section 268(1) and the provisions of this Act shall, so far as may be, apply accordingly as if the notice were a notice issued under that section.
